name: cmd_ring_push
note: Push command+param on the helper ring; drops when full

name: palette_fade_step
note: One palette, one brightness step, sets or clears its done bit (bit 31-index)

name: palette_fade_all
note: All banks: step and sum done masks; sum -4 means all black. Includes 0x183f8 bank loop

name: route_fade_out_wait
note: Route wait: set ff837b, push 0x800, sleep until cleared, two object-clear frames. MAME-measured durations in route_wait_test

name: route_fade_in_wait
note: Same with 0x804, no object clear

name: fade_helper_task
note: Helper task: starts the palette child, polls ff8378, clears palette RAM, settle sleep, clears ff837b

name: fade_out_child
note: Palette fade task, darken per sleep until sum -4, then two flip frames, sets ff8378

name: fade_in_child
note: Brighten until sum 0, clears ff8378

name: gameplay_loop_task
note: See notes: tick loop, input latch, route dispatch, exit

name: idle_task
note: Fast-forward decrement and helper command ring drain

name: audio_vblank_tick
note: Vblank: stereo option to Z80, music delay countdown, then one send

name: audio_send_pending
note: One ring entry to the Z80 mailbox when handshake reads 0xff

name: audio_enqueue
note: Gameplay enqueue; silently dropped in attract with demo sound off

name: audio_enqueue_always
note: Enqueue 3 longs; 63 usable entries; nonzero when full, caller ignores it

name: audio_ring_clear
note: Zero the ring at boot; pointers cleared separately at 0xc16

name: audio_stop_all
note: Clear current music, send control 0: everything stops

name: audio_key_off_channel
note: Control 2 for channel d0&15: key off one SFX channel

name: audio_stop_music
note: Clear current music, send control 5

name: audio_control
note: Control 6: music fade in at rate

name: audio_control
note: Control 7: music fade out at rate

name: audio_control
note: Control 8: music tempo offset; one caller, 0xb457e

name: audio_control
note: Control 9: music tuning offset f01b; one caller, 0xb461a

name: audio_control
note: Control a: Z80 flag f041; one caller

name: audio_control
note: Control b: clears f041; one caller

name: audio_control
note: Control c: no callers; Z80 also rejects it (CP 12). Dead both sides

name: audio_control
note: Control d: no callers; Z80 also rejects it. Dead both sides

name: audio_play_alternating
note: Sound pair with toggle byte and actor pan; pair on separate channels

name: audio_play_alternating
note: As 0x1aa6, next pair

name: audio_music_request
note: Music change: same-number no-op; fade out with delay, or start with optional fade in

name: audio_voice_with_actor_pan
note: Pan from actor x minus camera; no RAM effect, exercised through the audio_alt_* gates
